note: What is removing '.html' from INERT_EXTENSIONS actually load-bearing FOR? Not index.html — spec-low2b/ABL-low2-inert measured that EXTRA_SCANNED_FILES reads by explicit path and bypasses the extension filter. The extension change can only matter for a .html file UNDER src/, of which there are none today. These cases create one so the claim is measured rather than asserted. Read the FIRED RULE, not just the colour: the file-count pin moves too, so each arm carries its own consistent count.
